[EN] Mechanical problems are easy to solve. Add or subtract. Simple.

Zolyn is a riddle I can't solve, but I'll keep trying. I'll make her my friend!
[ES] Los problemas mecánicos son fáciles de resolver. Sumar o restar. Simple.

Zolyn es un acertijo que no puedo resolver, ¡pero seguiré intentándolo! ¡Haré que sea mi amiga!
